title: Microsoft -Pure AI -Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions – AI Engineer Senior:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer (Senior Consultant) to design, develop, and deploy intelligent agent-based solutions leveraging Microsoft AI technologies. This role focuses on building scalable AI-driven applications and enhancing enterprise processes through automation and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop AI-driven solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent-based frameworks.
* Build, test, and deploy intelligent agents using Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#).
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components.
* Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Design and develop AI-driven solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent-based frameworks.
* Build, test, and deploy intelligent agents using Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#).
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components.
* Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards.
* Ability to work effectively in distributed, onshore–offshore delivery models.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* The following skills are preferred and add value to the role:
* Experience with Power Platform.
* Experience with Azure Integration Services.
* Experience supporting large transformation or digital modernization programs
* Familiarity with testing tools, deployment cycles, and release management practices
* Experience working across multiple industries or complex business environments

**What We Look For**

* Total Experience: [4+ Years]
* Relevant Experience (AI/Agent-based solutions): 1+ Years
* Prior experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise delivery engagements.
* Degree in BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent with relevant industry experience.
* Microsoft AI certification is preferred.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: AI SOC- Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte Cyber to help organizations navigate the evolving threat landscape through managed services, advanced analytics, and resilient security operations. In this role, you will support clients in strengthening cyber defense capabilities, simplifying complexity, and operating with greater confidence.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the CDR Automation team, you will help clients evolve Security Operations Centers from playbook-driven automation toward AI-augmented, agentic operations.
  
  

* Design and develop automation and orchestration solutions using SOAR platforms to support and scale Security Operations
* Build and operationalize AI-assisted workflows, including autonomous triage, enrichment, and agent-driven use cases within SOC playbooks
* Develop integrations across security technologies using APIs, connectors, and orchestration platforms
* Define and implement operational improvements that reduce analyst effort, improve response efficiency, and strengthen SOC processes
* Manage implementation activities, stakeholder communications, and issue resolution across client, vendor, and Deloitte teams

**The team**
Cyber Defense & Resilience teams assist clients in defending against advanced threats by transforming security operations, and by monitoring technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence. They help manage and protect dynamic attack surfaces and provide rapid crisis and cyber incident response, thereby ensuring that clients can be ready for, respond to, and recover from business disruptions. Examples of work include Operational Resilience, Crisis & Incident Response, and Security Operations Center Transformation. As part of Deloitte’s Cyber Defense & Resilience portfolio, our SecOps teams’ partner with clients to strengthen security operations and cyber resilience. We deliver end-to-end services—from strategic assessments and innovation workshops to implementing next-generation SIEM and AI-SOC solutions—enabling proactive risk identification and mitigation across digital environments. Leveraging advanced analytics, AI-driven detection, agentic automation, and optimized data management, we provide continuous monitoring and rapid response to emerging threats. This integrated approach empowers organizations to build robust, future-ready security postures and confidently navigate an evolving cyber threat landscape.
  
  
**Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai**
**Shift Timings: General**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 6-10 years of experience developing solutions using Python or JavaScript
* Experience working in a Security Operations Center or Security Information and Event Management operations environment
* Experience building, testing, and maintaining Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response playbooks and automations in production
* Experience integrating systems through application programming interfaces in client-server, web, or microservices environments
* Knowledge of Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol, Domain Name System, and Hypertext Transfer Protocol
* Experience using GitHub or other version control repositories
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience integrating artificial intelligence services, agents, or large language model workflows into Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response or AI-SOC playbooks
* 6-10 years of experience in security information or technology engineering support
* Experience with security operations tools such as Security Information and Event Management, Endpoint Detection and Response, Web Application Firewall, Data Loss Prevention, or threat intelligence platforms
* Experience using MITRE ATT&CK for threat analysis or mitigation mapping
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional, GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst, GIAC Continuous Monitoring, GIAC Certified Incident Handler, Certified Ethical Hacker, or equivalent certification
* Experience developing dashboards or widgets using Flask or Django

title: Lead Specialist, Technology Solutions - Agentic Automations
description:
**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple:
**Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

  
  

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher-value work while accelerating business transformation.

  
  

The
**Office of the CTO**
powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital & Technology (D&T), the
**AgentOps Team**
leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.

  
  

**Why Join AgentOps?**

  
  

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.

  
  

You will:

  

  
* Build cutting-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
  
  
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight
  
  
* Solve high-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies
  
  
* Influence enterprise-wide AI engineering and automation standards
  
  
* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly
  

  

**Role Overview**

  
  

The
**Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations**
is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end-to-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.

  
  

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

  
  

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

  
  

You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Business Analysis & Opportunity Discovery**

  

  
* Lead end-to-end requirements gathering, process discovery, and stakeholder workshops for agentic automation initiatives.
  
  
* Analyze business processes to identify opportunities for intelligent automation, autonomous agents, and AI-driven workflow transformation.
  
  
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions with SMEs, product owners, operational teams, and business leaders.
  
  
* Document and validate business requirements, use cases, process maps, and success criteria.
  
  
* Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics.
  
  
* Establish measurable ROI, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost optimization objectives.
  

  

**Solution Design & Agentic Architecture**

  

  
* Design intelligent workflows, multi-agent systems, and semi-autonomous business processes.
  
  
* Define agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, decision frameworks, escalation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
* Create comprehensive solution artifacts including:
  
  
* Process Design Documents (PDDs)
  
  
* Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
  
  
* User Journeys
  
  
* Process Flows
  
  
* System Interaction Diagrams
  
  
* Agent Behavior Models
  
  
* Data & Integration Specifications
  
  
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to establish scalable and reusable design patterns.
  
  
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise platform, integration, security, and governance standards.
  

  

**Agentic AI & Automation Delivery**

  

  
* Lead the functional design and implementation of agentic automation solutions.
  
  
* Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and automation specialists throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Design workflows incorporating:
  
  
* Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents
  
  
* Human review and approval stages
  
  
* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops
  
  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  
  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
description:
**Company Overview**
At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
  
  
**THE TEAM & ROLE**
Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

**OUR TECH STACK:**
REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
* Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.

**#ZEOLife at Zuora**
As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it’s exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as “ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we’re making what’s next possible for our customers, community and the world.
  
  
As Part Of Our Commitment To Building An Inclusive, High-performance Culture Where ZEOs Feel Inspired, Connected And Valued, We Support ZEOs With
  
  
Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs
  
  
Medical, dental and vision insurance
  
  
Generous, flexible time off
  
  
Paid holidays, “wellness” days and company wide end of year break
  
  
Learning & Development stipend
  
  
Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match
  
  
Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing
  
  

* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.

Location & Work Arrangements
  
  
Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.
  
  
Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
  
  
Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.
  
  
Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.

title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy
description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle.
  
  
The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data-intensive solutions for regulated or asset-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities.
* Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long-term platform direction.
* Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans.
* Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
* Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting.
* Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers’ physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows.
* Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer-specific systems of record.
* Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption.
* Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity.
* Establish outcome-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact.
* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service-level objectives, and operational readiness.
* Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes.
* Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness.
* Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer-focused engineering culture.
* Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required.
* Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices.

**First 6-12 Months**
The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer-facing teams to confirm the highest-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan.
  
  
Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest-value Unify Energy capabilities.

title: Analyst, Algorithm Research & Development
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Measurement, Analytics and Control (MACH) division is KLA’s software powerhouse, responsible for developing high-performance software platforms that support semiconductor manufacturing. MACH delivers cutting-edge technologies in patterning analytics, modeling, and data science—empowering chipmakers to ramp next-gen devices faster and more efficiently. Our cross-functional team of research scientists, software engineers, apps engineers and process engineers are solving the industry’s most complex technical problems.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an intellectually curious and technically exceptional AI Engineer to join our Applied AI Research organization.
  
  
This role is designed for individuals who enjoy moving beyond application of established techniques and are motivated by solving problems that have no obvious solution. The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in machine learning, statistical algorithms, deep learning, and agentic AI systems to create next-generation intelligence platforms for semiconductor manufacturing and engineering.
  
  
Unlike traditional software engineering roles, this position requires a strong research mindset. We are looking for engineers who question assumptions, derive first-principles understanding of problems, conduct systematic experimentation, and translate emerging research into practical business impact.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to grow into a future technical and research leader capable of influencing the direction of AI, analytics, and intelligent automation across the organization.
  
  
**Vision for the Role**
Over the next several years, this individual is expected to evolve from an AI engineer into a recognized research leader who:
  
  

* Shapes the organization's AI strategy through technical innovation.
* Drives a culture of experimentation and evidence-based decision making.
* Bridges cutting-edge AI research with real-world engineering applications.
* Identifies transformational technologies before they become mainstream.
* Inspires teams to pursue ambitious technical challenges.
* Builds an innovation ecosystem through mentorship, technical leadership, and collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Applied AI Research**

* Investigate emerging AI techniques and evaluate their applicability to semiconductor manufacturing and engineering workflows.
* Conduct hands-on research in areas such as:

+ Foundation Models
+ Agentic AI Systems
+ Scientific Machine Learning
+ Computer Vision
+ Reinforcement Learning
+ Probabilistic Modeling
+ Knowledge Representation
+ Multi-Agent Systems
+ Causal AI

* Develop novel approaches for solving difficult engineering and manufacturing problems.
* Design rigorous experimental frameworks to validate hypotheses and quantify impact.
* Translate research findings into scalable product capabilities.

**Statistical Learning & Algorithm Development**
Design and develop advanced algorithms utilizing:
  
  

* Bayesian Inference
* Probabilistic Graphical Models
* Design of Experiments (DOE)
* Time-Series Analysis
* Optimization Techniques
* Causal Inference
* Anomaly Detection
* Predictive Modeling
* Multivariate Statistics
* Graph Analytics

Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Creating explainable and scientifically sound models.
* Evaluating statistical significance of experimental outcomes.
* Building decision-support and autonomous reasoning systems.

**Deep Learning & Scientific AI**
Develop next-generation deep learning solutions for:
  
  

* Defect Management
* Yield Analytics
* Manufacturing Optimization
* Image Understanding
* Pattern Recognition
* Engineering Knowledge Discovery

Work with and innovate on:
  
  

* CNNs
* Vision Transformers
* Multimodal Models
* Graph Neural Networks
* Self-Supervised Learning
* Representation Learning
* Foundation Models
* Diffusion Architectures

Candidates should be comfortable reading research papers, reproducing published techniques, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  
  
**Agentic AI & Intelligent Systems**
Develop intelligent autonomous systems capable of:
  
  

* Planning
* Reasoning
* Tool Usage
* Workflow Orchestration
* Long-Horizon Goal Achievement

Build sophisticated AI systems using:
  
  

* LangGraph
* Semantic Kernel
* AutoGen
* CrewAI
* OpenAI Agent Frameworks
* MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Examples include:
  
  

* AI Copilots
* Manufacturing Assistants
* Engineering Intelligence Platforms
* Autonomous Analytics Systems
* Knowledge Agents

**Software Engineering Excellence**
Develop production-grade solutions using:
  
  
**Primary Languages**

* Python
* Modern C++ (C++17/20)

**Additional Technologies**

* PyTorch
* Ray
* Spark
* Kubernetes
* Docker
* Vector Databases
* Graph Databases

The candidate should be able to transform research prototypes into scalable and maintainable products.
  
  
**Research Leadership Expectations**
Although this is an individual contributor role, the candidate is expected to actively contribute to building a research culture.
  
  
This includes:
  
  

* Leading technical reading groups.
* Reviewing and discussing recent research papers.
* Driving internal innovation initiatives.
* Mentoring junior engineers on research methodology.
* Promoting first-principles thinking.
* Encouraging experimentation and hypothesis-driven development.
* Establishing engineering rigor around benchmarking and evaluation.

Success is measured not only by feature delivery but also by the advancement of the team's collective technical capability.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
**Education**
MS or PhD preferred in:
  
  

* Computer Science
* Machine Learning
* Artificial Intelligence
* Statistics
* Applied Mathematics
* Electrical Engineering
* Related STEM discipline

**Experience**
Typically:
  
  

* BS + 5 years
* OR MS + 3 years
* OR PhD

Demonstrated experience in building production AI systems while maintaining strong interest in research and innovation.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is someone who:
  
  

* Reads research papers for fun.
* Questions conventional assumptions.
* Enjoys tackling open-ended technical challenges.
* Can move seamlessly from theory to implementation.
* Has strong mathematical intuition.
* Is passionate about creating new knowledge, not merely applying existing solutions.
* Wants to become a future Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, or AI Research Leader.

**What Success Looks Like After 3-5 Years**
This engineer will have:
  
  

* Become a recognized technical authority in AI and analytics.
* Influenced the AI roadmap for multiple products.
* Originated innovations that materially impact product differentiation.
* Built a thriving culture of experimentation and technical excellence.
* Mentored the next generation of AI engineers and researchers.
* Established KLA as a leader in AI-native semiconductor manufacturing intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

description:

  **technical expertise, solution architecture capabilities, and the ability to lead AI initiatives from Concept to Production.**

**Details of Employment:**

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Work Location**
– Guindy Olympia Tech Park OR SIPCOT Siruseri.

**Mode of Employment**
- 3 days Hybrid in the Office.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent.

**Notice Period**
- 0 to 15 days from the date of the offer (
**Critical Requisition; hence the ask**
)

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Architecture and Solution Design**

* Architect and lead the development of enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies using Azure AI Search, FAISS, and Pinecone.
* Design and implement Agentic AI systems incorporating autonomous agents, multi-step planning, tool orchestration, reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Develop AI solutions that integrate with internal systems, including trading platforms, operations workbenches, and risk engines, to automate decision support, exception handling, and reporting.
* Establish standards for prompt engineering, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, A/B testing, and automated regression testing.

**2. Azure Cloud and AI Platform Engineering**

* Lead the design, implementation, and management of AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient AI inference pipelines using caching, request batching, and token-budget optimization.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models and AI agents, incorporating model versioning, controlled deployments, A/B testing, rollback mechanisms, and observability.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud governance, data residency, and security requirements using Azure Private Endpoints, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related security controls.

**3. AI Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose and resolve production AI performance issues, including inference latency, embedding drift, retrieval quality degradation, hallucinations, and context-window limitations.
* Monitor and optimize token consumption, API rate limits, throughput, and cost per query across production AI workloads.
* Establish AI observability through structured logging, distributed tracing across prompt processing, retrieval, and generation, and dashboards tracking latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval recall, and answer relevance.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of AI system failures, including incorrect tool invocations, RAG retrieval failures, safety-filter false positives, and model regressions following version upgrades.

**4. Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 AI/ML engineers, overseeing code reviews, architecture decisions, sprint planning, engineering standards, and professional development.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, quantitative teams, and operations leaders to translate business requirements into scalable, production-ready AI solutions.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, model releases, fine-tuning techniques, agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and CrewAI, and AI evaluation methodologies.
* Represent the AI engineering function in technical design reviews, architecture governance forums, and incident post-mortems.
* Drive engineering best practices and continuous improvement across AI solution design, development, deployment, monitoring, security, and operational support.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on AI/ML solutions in production environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with RAG architectures, including vector databases, embedding pipelines, chunking strategies, hybrid search (keyword + semantic), re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation.
* Proven track record of building Agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning loops, memory management, and fallback strategies.
* Strong proficiency in Azure Cloud services, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search), Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, AKS, and App Service.
* Experience troubleshooting AI performance issues, including inference latency optimization, token budgeting, embedding drift detection, hallucination mitigation, and cost management at scale.
* Proficiency in Python and at least one of the following: C#/.NET or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, including transformers, attention mechanisms, fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), RLHF, and evaluation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, faithfulness, and relevance.
* Experience leading engineering teams of 4+ members in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and prepare clear technical documentation.

Resumes can be shared with
**devika.raju@kumaran.com**

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About the role

You will be the architect who wins the technical deal. Before a contract is signed, you show enterprise customers that their AI agents will work, at their scale and under their rules. You build the demos and proofs of concept, answer the architecture questions, and hand delivery a plan they can execute. This is a hands-on engineering role in front of customers. You write code most weeks and spend the rest with CIOs, platform teams and risk officers. You report to the Co-Founder and CTO.

What you will do

• Discover: run technical discovery with CIOs, platform-engineering and risk teams at banks, insurers and asset managers. Map their systems, data and controls to the agent use cases that matter.

• Demo: build tailored demos of agent workflows, using the customer's own scenarios where you can.

• De-risk: answer security, compliance and model-risk questionnaires (SOC 2, data residency, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls).

• Hand off: turn every won proof of concept into a delivery plan our forward-deployed engineers can run from day one.

• Feed back: bring field patterns to product and build reusable demo assets, templates and starter agents.

What we are looking for

• 8+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture or forward-deployed engineering for enterprise customers.

• Hands-on experience building LLM applications or agents: prompt and tool design, RAG, evaluation, and at least one agent framework.

• Strong Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, containers and one major cloud.

• Comfort in regulated environments, where governance, auditability and access control decide the deal.

• Consulting experience: client-facing work, scoping engagements and running workshops with enterprise stakeholders.

• Understanding of tool calling and MCP, guardrails and policy controls, access management, observability and audit trails.

Nice to have

• Experience selling to, or working inside, financial services.

• Kubernetes, observability or AIOps tooling.

• AWS, Azure or GCP certifications.

Location: Chennai, India (Chennai office), hybrid 3 days on-site, with travel to customer sites as needed.

title: AICTE Postdoctoral Fellowship in Neuromorphic Computing
description:
About Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham

Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a leading multi-campus, multi-disciplinary research university in India, nationally recognised for its research output and academic excellence. The university has eight campuses across five Indian states, with its headquarters in Ettimadai, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.

Amrita runs regular student and researcher exchange programmes with top universities in the United States, including Ivy League institutions, and with leading European universities. It is one of the fastest-growing institutions of higher learning in the country. Fellows get an international outlook, modern facilities and strong institutional support for high-impact research.

About the Fellowship

Applications are invited for a full-time, on-site
**Postdoctoral Fellowship in Neuromorphic Computing**
, offered under the
**AICTE Postdoctoral Fellowship scheme**
. The fellow will be based at Amrita’s Chennai campus.

The fellow will join an interdisciplinary research environment spanning semiconductor physics, computing and engineering. They will carry out original research in neuromorphic computing.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct original research in neuromorphic computing, including designing and running experiments and developing models
* Analyse experimental and simulation data
* Carry out hands-on laboratory work and collaborate with faculty and research teams
* Prepare manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals
* Present results at conferences and internal seminars
* Mentor graduate and undergraduate students
* Contribute to grant proposals
* Support collaborative projects with national and international partners

Eligibility and Qualifications

**Essential**

* PhD in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics or a closely related discipline, or equivalent research experience (subject to AICTE PDF eligibility norms)
* Strong research skills, including experimental design, literature review and scientific writing
* Laboratory skills relevant to neuromorphic computing or closely related areas
* A solid foundation in electronic devices, circuits and systems
* Competence in data analysis, including statistical methods, numerical modelling and relevant software tools
* Strong programming skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB or similar)
* Familiarity with simulation tools used in neuromorphic and device-level research
* Ability to work collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams
* Clear written and spoken communication of research findings in English
* Willingness to work on-site in Chennai and engage fully with Amrita’s research and academic community

**Highly desirable**

* Experience in one or more of the following:
* neuromorphic hardware
* computational neuroscience
* AI/ML for neuromorphic systems
* VLSI

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a Technical Lead for Genesys Cloud solutions within a hybrid work model applying deep expertise in quality monitoring speech analytics and APIs to optimize contact center operations in auto claims and property and casualty insurance. Drive high impact technical initiatives that improve customer experience operational efficiency and compliance for a global organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end to end technical design and implementation of Genesys Cloud solutions to support complex contact center workflows for auto claims and property and casualty insurance operations.
* Oversee configuration and optimization of Genesys Cloud quality monitoring features to ensure thorough evaluation of agent interactions and continuous service performance improvement.
* Drive development and integration of Genesys Cloud APIs to connect customer communication channels with policy systems and claims platforms in a secure and scalable manner.
* Provide hands on guidance in tuning speech analytics models to identify customer sentiment trends and claims related issues that inform business decisions and process enhancements.
* Coordinate with claims operations and underwriting teams to translate domain requirements from auto claims and property and casualty insurance into robust Genesys Cloud technical solutions.
* Implement monitoring and alerting mechanisms around Genesys Cloud services and APIs to ensure high availability low latency and rapid incident response in a day shift environment.
* Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to design call flows routing strategies and interaction policies that improve claim handling efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Execute structured code reviews configuration audits and documentation updates for Genesys Cloud components to maintain regulatory compliance and technical standards alignment.
* Analyze interaction data from quality monitoring and speech analytics to propose targeted improvements in claims handling scripts workflows and agent coaching programs.
* Guide junior engineers in best practices for Genesys Cloud development integration and troubleshooting while maintaining focus on customer and business outcomes rather than formal people management.
* Conduct impact assessments and proof of concept activities for new Genesys Cloud features or API integrations that can enhance automation in claims intake and policy servicing.
* Coordinate hybrid work collaboration using secure tools and standardized processes to ensure consistent progress across onsite and remote team members without travel requirements.
* Document solution designs technical decisions and operational runbooks clearly so that support teams can manage Genesys Cloud environments effectively during day shifts.

**Qualifications**

* Apply extensive experience of seven to ten years in enterprise contact center technologies with a focus on Genesys Cloud platforms quality monitoring and speech analytics to deliver reliable solutions.
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in designing and consuming Genesys Cloud APIs including authentication data mapping and error handling patterns for insurance domain integrations.
* Bring solid understanding of auto claims processes and property and casualty insurance lifecycles to shape technical configurations that align with regulatory expectations and customer service goals.
* Utilize practical experience in hybrid work models to manage time communication and collaboration effectively across distributed technical and business teams.
* Exhibit proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues in Genesys Cloud environments using logs metrics and analytic insights to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence.
* Apply knowledge of contact center metrics and key performance indicators to interpret quality monitoring and speech analytics outputs into actionable recommendations.
* Show comfort working with enterprise change management and release processes ensuring that Genesys Cloud updates and API changes are deployed in a controlled and documented manner.

title: AI Architect
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced AI Architect to lead the agentic AI engineering function, taking ownership of the design, architecture, and quality of AI agents across the platform.

The role involves defining engineering standards for prompt design, agent evaluation, and Large Language Model (LLM) integration. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise in AI/ML engineering with strong architectural leadership, ensuring AI agents are reliable, scalable, accurate, and cost-effective in production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and establish the agent engineering framework, including orchestration patterns, prompt governance, and tool-calling standards.
* Lead design reviews for AI agent implementations across the engineering team.
* Own the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline architecture, including embedding strategies, retrieval optimisation, and accuracy benchmarks.
* Define and implement agent evaluation frameworks covering golden datasets, confidence calibration, and regression testing.
* Establish prompt engineering standards and lead the prompt review board.
* Mentor junior-level (JL1) engineers in agent development, testing, and evaluation.
* Monitor and optimise AI agent performance in production, focusing on latency, cost, and accuracy.
* Drive engineering best practices across agent design, LLM integration, and production deployment.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, including at least 5 years working with production-grade LLM systems.
* Deep expertise in prompt engineering, AI agent design, and LLM integration.
* Proven experience architecting and scaling RAG pipelines.
* Strong understanding of agent evaluation techniques, including hallucination testing, confidence scoring, and regression testing frameworks.
* Expert-level Python programming skills.
* Experience leading AI/ML engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of LLM cost management, token budgeting, and latency optimisation.

AI Architect

* Familiarity with TypeScript and Node.js.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or other tool-calling standards.
* Background in building enterprise AI platforms.
* Knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) or IT operations domains.

title: Head of AI Division – Enterprise AI, Generative AI & Agentic Platforms
description:
Role Overview

Our company is seeking an accomplished
**Head of AI Division**
to lead its enterprise-wide Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation initiatives. This is a senior leadership position responsible for defining the AI vision, building and scaling AI capabilities, establishing enterprise AI platforms, and driving measurable business transformation across the organization's engineering, product, and operational ecosystems.

The ideal candidate will bring 20+ years of experience across software engineering, enterprise architecture, technology leadership, and platform development, including substantial hands-on experience in designing and deploying production-grade AI and Generative AI solutions.

The role requires a unique combination of executive leadership, deep technical expertise, product and business acumen, and the ability to transform emerging AI technologies into secure, scalable, and commercially valuable enterprise solutions.

The Head of AI Division will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Product, Operations, Architecture, and Customer Success teams to establish AI as a strategic organizational capability, accelerate innovation, improve engineering productivity, and deliver sustainable business value.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise AI Strategy & Business Transformation

* Define and execute Solartis' enterprise AI strategy, vision, and multi-year transformation roadmap.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and AI-powered decision systems across products and business functions.
* Translate business objectives into scalable AI initiatives with clearly defined outcomes, investment priorities, and measurable ROI.
* Establish enterprise AI reference architectures, technology standards, implementation frameworks, and reusable accelerators.
* Advise executive leadership on AI adoption, emerging technologies, investment priorities, opportunities, and associated risks.
* Drive an AI-first engineering and product development culture across the organization.

2. AI Division Leadership & Organizational Development

* Build, lead, and scale a high-performing AI division comprising AI architects, AI/ML engineers, Generative AI specialists, platform engineers, and research or innovation teams.
* Define the organizational structure, operating model, hiring strategy, capability development plans, and performance expectations for the AI division.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability across AI strategy, architecture, engineering, platform development, and production operations.
* Mentor senior technical leaders and develop a strong leadership pipeline within the AI organization.
* Foster collaboration across Engineering, Product, Security, Infrastructure, Operations, and business stakeholders.
* Manage resource allocation, delivery priorities, technology investments, and AI program budgets.

3. Enterprise Generative AI & Foundation Model Strategy

* Lead the evaluation, selection, architecture, and enterprise adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and open-source foundation models.
* Establish model selection, routing, orchestration, fine-tuning, inference optimization, and deployment strategies aligned with business requirements.
* Drive the adoption of platforms and technologies such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and other relevant foundation models.
* Define strategies for balancing model performance, security, latency, scalability, licensing, and inference costs.
* Oversee the development of enterprise AI services, reusable frameworks, APIs, SDKs, and shared platform capabilities.

4. Enterprise RAG & Knowledge Intelligence Platforms

* Lead the architecture and implementation of enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platforms and knowledge intelligence systems.
* Establish scalable architectures integrating structured and unstructured enterprise data, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases, and knowledge graphs.
* Drive improvements in retrieval accuracy, contextual relevance, response quality, grounding, and hallucination mitigation.
* Oversee enterprise knowledge assistants, AI copilots, intelligent search solutions, and domain-specific AI applications.
* Establish standards for data access, source attribution, information security, and evaluation of knowledge-grounded AI systems.

5. Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation

* Define the enterprise roadmap for autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, and intelligent workflow orchestration.
* Lead the design and deployment of AI systems capable of planning, reasoning, tool use, task execution, and controlled decision support.
* Drive Agentic AI adoption across software engineering, testing, customer support, business operations, and relevant domain-specific workflows.
* Establish frameworks for agent orchestration, memory management, human-in-the-loop controls, exception handling, and safe execution.
* Define standards for agent observability, evaluation, access control, governance, and operational reliability.
* Ensure that autonomous workflows operate within clearly defined business rules, permissions, and accountability boundaries.

6. AI Platform Engineering & Production Delivery

* Own the architecture, engineering, deployment, and scaling of enterprise AI platforms in production environments.
* Establish engineering practices for MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps, including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Drive the development of production-ready AI applications using robust APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native platforms.
* Establish end-to-end AI evaluation frameworks covering quality, accuracy, reliability, security, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise requirements for availability, resilience, performance, maintainability, and operational support.
* Maintain strong technical oversight of critical architecture decisions, engineering standards, and production implementations.

7. AI-Powered Engineering Transformation

* Lead enterprise-wide adoption of AI-assisted software development and intelligent engineering workflows.
* Drive AI-enabled code generation, code review, automated testing, documentation, developer assistance, and DevOps automation.
* Partner with engineering leadership to identify productivity bottlenecks and establish measurable improvements in software delivery.
* Develop frameworks to assess AI-assisted engineering quality, developer productivity, defect reduction, and delivery efficiency.
* Promote responsible adoption of AI development tools while maintaining software quality, intellectual property protection, and security standards.

8. AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI

* Establish enterprise AI governance frameworks covering responsible AI, privacy, security, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
* Define policies for model access, data protection, prompt injection mitigation, sensitive information handling, and AI application security.
* Ensure appropriate human oversight, auditability, explainability, and traceability for AI-assisted and agent-driven decisions.
* Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, and Architecture teams to establish risk-based controls for enterprise AI adoption.
* Implement governance mechanisms for model evaluation, production approval, change management, incident response, and continuous monitoring.

9. Technology Innovation & Strategic Partnerships

* Lead AI innovation programs, technology incubation, proofs of concept, and enterprise-scale pilots.
* Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, foundation models, orchestration technologies, and industry developments.
* Establish strategic technology partnerships and guide build-versus-buy decisions.
* Convert promising AI experiments into scalable production capabilities with clear adoption and business-value criteria.
* Represent the organization in strategic technology discussions and provide thought leadership to executive management.

10. Portfolio, Budget & Business Outcome Management

* Own the AI division's delivery portfolio, investment priorities, resource utilization, and operational performance.
* Establish governance for AI project prioritization, delivery milestones, dependencies, and risk management.
* Define measurable business cases for AI initiatives and track their impact on productivity, operating costs, quality, customer experience, and revenue opportunities.
* Communicate portfolio performance, investment requirements, delivery risks, and realized business value to executive stakeholders.
* Ensure that AI investments deliver sustainable outcomes rather than isolated proofs of concept.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **20+ years of overall experience**
  in software engineering, technology architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology leadership.
* Significant experience leading large engineering, architecture, AI/ML, or platform engineering organizations.
* Strong hands-on technical foundation in AI/ML and Generative AI, with demonstrable experience designing and deploying enterprise AI solutions in production.
* Proven track record of defining technology strategy and translating it into successful enterprise-scale implementation.
* Experience building and scaling technical teams, leading senior architects and engineering managers, and managing complex technology portfolios.
* Demonstrated ability to engage with executive stakeholders and align AI investments with business priorities.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, application security, and production engineering.

Mandatory Technical Expertise

Candidates must demonstrate substantial expertise across the core areas below. Equivalent technologies are acceptable where the candidate has strong architecture and implementation experience.

**Generative AI & Foundation Models**

* LLMs, SLMs, prompt engineering, model evaluation, fine-tuning, embeddings, inference optimization, and model orchestration.
* Experience with commercial and open-source models, such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, or equivalent platforms.

**RAG & Knowledge Systems**

* Enterprise RAG architecture, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, vector databases, and knowledge-grounded AI applications.
* Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with vector platforms such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Azure AI Search, or equivalent.

**Agentic AI & Orchestration**

* AI agent architecture, multi-agent workflows, planning, reasoning, tool calling, memory, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Agent governance, observability, evaluation, reliability, and secure execution.

**AI Platform Engineering**

* Production AI platform development, MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, CI/CD, model lifecycle management, monitoring, and evaluation.
* AI application security, governance, scalability, performance, and cost optimization.

**Cloud & Enterprise Architecture**

* Strong experience with at least one major cloud ecosystem: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI); familiarity with GCP is beneficial.
* Kubernetes, containers, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures.
* Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise applications, data ecosystems, identity systems, and security controls.

**Programming & Engineering**

* Strong proficiency in Python and practical understanding of AI application development.
* Experience with REST APIs, enterprise integration, and production software engineering.
* Familiarity with .NET and Microsoft enterprise technology ecosystems is advantageous.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in Insurance, InsurTech, Financial Services, Healthcare, or enterprise SaaS environments.
* Experience building enterprise AI copilots, intelligent workflow platforms, autonomous agents, and knowledge assistants.
* Experience leading AI transformation across multiple business units or large engineering organizations.
* Exposure to enterprise risk management, regulatory requirements, responsible AI, and security governance.
* Experience managing technology budgets, vendor relationships, strategic partnerships, and executive-level reporting.
* A track record of measurable improvements in business performance through AI adoption.

Leadership Competencies

* Enterprise-level strategic thinking combined with strong technical judgment.
* Proven ability to build, lead, and scale high-performing technology organizations.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
