**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w
  
  
**Department Context**
The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables the Bank's operational business processes through modern, flexible and user-friendly digital products. Its portfolio includes Operations Workspace and related solutions that bring together operational data, documents, workflows, collaboration and decision support for front-line staff.
  
  
ITSOP is seeking an Associate Senior Solutions Architect to provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership for the Operations Workspace ecosystem. The successful candidate will combine deep Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse expertise with strong .NET and Azure engineering skills, personally implement prototypes and reference solutions, and guide delivery teams from design through production. The role will also help integrate Generative AI and agentic capabilities into operational workflows using a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC). This is not a purely advisory role.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect translates complex operational requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET, Azure, APIs, data platforms and AI services. The role defines architecture, validates choices through working code, establishes reusable patterns and guardrails, and remains directly engaged in troubleshooting, CI/CD, release readiness and production improvement.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect works across multiple projects in the World Bank Operations portfolio and is accountable for ensuring that technical solutions are successfully designed, delivered and operated for Operations staff.
  
  
From a work-program perspective, the role provides technical leadership, delivery oversight and practical guidance to internal staff and globally distributed vendor teams. The architect helps sequence technical work, resolves delivery constraints and ensures that implementation remains aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards and release commitments.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role leads application, integration and data architecture; identifies solution components and reusable patterns; validates designs through working prototypes; performs quality and code reviews; and remains accountable for delivery at speed, scale and quality.
  
  
**Role Scope and Distinction**

* Acts as a senior technical subject matter expert for complex, business-critical solutions in the Operations Workspace portfolio.
* Balances strategic architecture with recent, demonstrable hands-on contribution to prototypes, code, integration, deployment and technical problem-solving.
* Leads cross-layer design decisions involving applications, workflows, data, APIs, identity, security, observability and AI-enabled experiences.
* Guides multidisciplinary teams and vendors, mentors architects and engineers, and raises engineering quality through practical standards and reusable implementation assets.
* Works across globally distributed business, product, architecture, security, data, platform and engineering stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Operations Workspace and related products, aligning business outcomes, enterprise principles, security requirements and delivery constraints.
* Define target-state and transition architectures, solution options, architecture decision records, integration contracts, non-functional requirements and implementation roadmaps.
* Review designs and code for scalability, resilience, maintainability, interoperability, usability, performance and cost effectiveness.
* Identify systemic risks and technical debt, propose pragmatic remediation, and guide Agile Release Train and product teams through implementation trade-offs.

Lead solution delivery teams through implementation, maintenance, release readiness and operational improvement of business-critical applications supporting Operations Workspace and related Operations product ecosystems.
  
  
Lead application and data architecture modelling, component identification and solution quality reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and approved technology standards.
  
  
**Dynamics 365 and Dataverse Engineering**

* Architect and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse solutions, including data models, security roles, business rules, workflows, plug-ins, custom actions, Power Platform components and environment strategy.
* Design supported extension patterns using C#/.NET, the Dataverse SDK and APIs while minimizing fragile customization and preserving upgradeability.
* Guide integration of Dynamics 365 with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, enterprise data products and other operational systems.
* Define application lifecycle management practices for solutions, configuration, environment variables, connection references, test data and controlled promotion across environments.

**Hands-on Prototyping and .NET Engineering**

* Personally design, code, test and demonstrate proofs of concept, technical spikes, reference implementations and minimum viable solutions.
* Develop secure APIs, services, plug-ins and integration components using C#, modern .NET, ASP.NET Core and RESTful patterns.
* Validate architecture choices through executable prototypes, performance tests and failure-mode testing before major delivery investment.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across user experience, application, integration, identity, data and infrastructure layers, and support teams during critical releases.

**Integration, Cloud and Platform Architecture**

* Design API-led, event-driven and workflow-based integrations using appropriate Azure services, API management, messaging, serverless and container patterns.
* Apply identity-first design using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege, secrets management and auditable authorization patterns, including B2E and approved external-access scenarios.
* Define observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards and actionable alerts across application and integration components.

title: Manager Engineering
description:
**Career Area**
Engineering
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
The Engineering Manager – Data Science is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing multiple pods of data scientists and machine learning engineers while ensuring high-quality, timely delivery of data science products and platforms. This role partners closely with AI product owners, AI architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to ensure data science solutions are technically sound, scalable, and aligned to strategic outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Leadership & Talent Development
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of data scientists and ML engineers
* Set clear performance expectations and support career development
* Foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture

Technical & Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Provide technical guidance across data science and ML solutions working closely with AI Architects
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards and MLOps practices
* Review model designs and deployment strategies

Delivery & Execution Management
  
  

* Own delivery execution and capacity planning
* Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery
* Manage risks, dependencies, and technical debt

Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with AI Product Owners and business stakeholders
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly

Quality, Governance & Responsible AI
  
  

* Ensure solutions meet quality, security, and compliance standards
* Uphold responsible AI principles

Degree Requirement
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Post Graduate or higher is desired.
  
  
Skill Descriptors
  
  
**Engineering Management**
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high‑performing technical teams delivering complex data science and machine learning solutions. Provides clear direction, sets expectations, and holds teams accountable for outcomes while supporting individual growth and engagement. Balances people leadership, technical oversight, and delivery execution in a fast‑moving environment.
  
  
**Data Science & Machine Learning**
Strong working knowledge of data science, machine learning, GenAI and statistical modeling concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation. Able to guide and review technical approaches, challenge assumptions, and ensure solutions are fit for purpose without requiring hands‑on model development as a primary responsibility.
  
  
**Delivery & Execution**
Proven ability to plan, prioritize, and execute work in Agile or hybrid delivery environments. Manages team capacity, dependencies, and risks to ensure predictable delivery of high‑quality outcomes. Uses data and metrics to assess progress, identify issues early, and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Communication & Collaboration**
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non‑technical audiences. Builds strong partnerships with product owners, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to align expectations, manage trade‑offs, and deliver value.
  
  
Software Development Life Cycle
  
  
Demonstrated knowledge of software and data science development life cycles, including experimentation, prototyping, production deployment, and ongoing operations. Understands the differences between research‑oriented work and production‑grade solutions and guides teams accordingly.
  
  

* Works within formal delivery and governance methodologies
* Understands phases, activities, dependencies, and key decision points across the life cycle
* Identifies common risks and quality considerations at each stage
* Interprets and guides technical documentation, design artifacts, and delivery plans

Artificial Intelligence
  
  
Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, GenAI and machine learning concepts, risks, and opportunities, with the ability to guide teams toward solutions that deliver business outcomes responsibly.
  
  

* Understands AI methodologies, capabilities, and limitations
* Guides teams in applying responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, robustness, and governance
* Keeps informed of emerging AI technologies and evaluates their applicability to business needs
* Supports the adoption of AI practices that balance innovation with risk management

Programming & Technical Literacy
  
  
Strong technical literacy across programming and data science tools sufficient to effectively review code, designs, and technical approaches.
  
  

* Able to assess code quality, maintainability, and architectural alignment
* Collaborates effectively with hands‑on engineers and data scientists
* Understands testing, version control, and deployment concepts
* Hands‑on coding is not a primary responsibility, but technical depth is sufficient to guide and challenge solutions

Technical Troubleshooting
  
  
Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex technical and operational issues across data, models, and production systems.
  
  

* Guides investigation and resolution of data, model, and system issues
* Reviews logs, metrics, and system behavior to support root cause analysis
* Partners with platform and operations teams to resolve production incidents
* Ensures issues are documented, learnings are captured, and preventative actions are implemented

Note
  
  
This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties, and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. It is expressly not intended to be a comprehensive list of “essential job functions” as that term is defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.
  
  
**Posting Dates**
October 16, 2026 - October 29, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

description:
**Who We Are?**

Cleantech Industry Resources accelerates United States solar, battery storage and EV projects by providing turnkey development as a service including 100% internal systems engineering. The company deploys a leading team that spun out of the largest solar power producer in the world. This team operates within a sophisticated suite of software to support projects from land origination, through to commercial operation.

Chennai

* Fantastic team environment and collaborative culture
* Professional development opportunities to grow into an industry leader
* Medical Insurance for the employee and family
* Spot Recognition bonus for exceptional performance
* Long Term Incentive policy
* Regular team outings, events, and activities to foster a positive work environment

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

At CIR, we are dedicated to nurturing a diverse and equitable workforce that truly reflects our community. We deeply value each person’s unique perspective, skills, and experiences. CIR embraces all individuals, regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or nationality. We are steadfast in our commitment to fostering a just and inclusive world through intentional policies and actions. Your individuality enriches our collective strength, and we strive to ensure everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered.

**Position Summary**

As a Drone and Robotics Engineer at CIR, you will develop and deploy automated solutions for inspecting and monitoring solar assets. You'll work with cross-functional teams to define use cases, integrate sensors and flight control systems (ROS/PX4/ArduPilot), and ensure safe, regulation-compliant drone operations. Your role includes analyzing imagery using AI/ML, maintaining robotic systems, and driving innovation through continuous testing and technology upgrades.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Define automation use cases and requirements:**
  Work with the automation and solar O&M teams to understand inspection and monitoring needs, translate them into robotics/drone system requirements and propose technical solutions.
* **Integrate hardware and software:**
  Develop flight control software and integrate GPS, LiDAR, thermal cameras and other sensors. Use ROS/PX4/ArduPilot frameworks to ensure reliable navigation and data capture.
* **Plan and execute inspections:**
  Plan flight paths and robotic missions for thermal imaging and visual inspections of panels, trackers and other infrastructure while complying with DGCA/UAS 2.0 regulations. Conduct preflight checks and ensure operational safety.
* **Process and analyze data:**
  High-Fidelity 3D Photogrammetry, Precision Point Cloud Generation, and Geometric Feature Extraction to process high-resolution and thermal imagery for hotspot detection, shading analysis and fault identification. Present results to stakeholders and integrate findings into maintenance workflows.
* **Testing and quality assurance:**
  Conduct laboratory and field tests to verify performance, identify mechanical/software issues and optimize system reliability before deployment.
* **Maintenance & troubleshooting:**
  Perform regular diagnostics, firmware updates and repairs on drones and robots. Establish maintenance schedules and keep detailed logs.
* **Compliance & documentation:**
  Ensure systems meet DGCA/FAA regulations and obtain necessary certifications. Produce documentation, standard operating procedures and training material for end-users.
* **Innovation & research:**
  Stay current with advancements in robotics, UAVs and AI; evaluate new sensors and technologies; and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and prototypes.
* **Collaboration and training:**
  Collaborate with software developers, GIS analysts and solar engineers; provide training to field technicians on robotic and drone operation; and communicate technical information clearly to nontechnical team members.

**Education Requirements**

Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or similar.

**Technical Skills and Experience**

**Software Proficiency:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or similar.
* 5+ years’ experience designing, building and testing drones or robots—preferably for infrastructure inspection .
* Experience in extracting geometric features from point clouds, such as roof pitch, façade dimensions, and calculating structural thickness from derived models."
* Expert-level proficiency in Photogrammetry and Point Cloud Processing: Deep, hands-on experience with commercial (e.g., Pix4D, Agisoft Metashape) or open-source photogrammetry software and libraries.
* Knowledge of AI/ML techniques for image and thermal data analysis.
* Proficiency in ROS/PX4/ArduPilot and sensor integration (RGB, GPS, IMUs, LiDAR)
* Understanding of UAS regulations and safety protocols (DGCA regulations in India, FAA Part 107 elsewhere).
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving; excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to work independently and in multidisciplinary teams.

**Psychosocial Skills /Human Skills/Behavioural Skills**

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ideas and run with them from concept to conclusion.
* Technical understanding of clean energy business processes
* Exceptional verbal and writing communication skills with superiors, peers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent interpersonal skills while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The physical demands of this job require an individual to be able to work at a computer for most of the day, be able to participate in conference calls and travel to team retreats on a time-to-time basis. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Work Conditions**

The work environment is usually quiet (normal city traffic noises are common), a blend of artificial and natural light, temperate and generally supports a collaborative work environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

At Cleantech Industry Resources, we embrace diversity and uphold a strong dedication to establishing an all-encompassing atmosphere for both our staff and associates. Our choices in employment are free from any bias related to race, creed, nationality, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, physical limitations, veteran status, or any other legally safeguarded attributes.

Being an integral part of Cleantech Industry Resources means you can expect to be immersed in a realm of professional possibilities within a culture that nurtures teamwork, adaptability, and the embracing of all.

title: Staff/Senior Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees:**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About the Role:**
To support the delivery of CloudBees products (both internal and external), our Operations team designs, deploys, secures and manages a variety of software systems and the related GCP / AWS infrastructure that underpins these software engineering objectives. Our guiding principle is simple - “Make Engineering Faster”. Underpinning this are the challenges of security, process change, technical change that all must be met to varying degrees. Further, we are passionate about reducing the manual work that plagues IT teams - Engineering / Ops / Support / Security - and are empowered to re-engineer processes and technology to achieve those objectives.
  
  
We are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Is able to troubleshoot complex issues calmly.
* An open communicator, capable of bringing new ideas to the team
* Is able to learn from colleagues at all levels
* Understands, and is motivated by, rapidly changing technologies and has demonstrable competence with modern AI tools.

You are:
  
  

* self-motivated and enjoy solving problems
* excited by the opportunity to automate yourself out of recurring workable to self-organize and document your work and decisions effectively
* You will liaise directly with the software engineers across all teams, ensuring that decisions are agreed internally and externally to Operations and that they meet our technical and non-technical objectives.

How you’ll work:
  
  

* In a geographically distributed team (APAC, US, EMEA) of peers
* Choose your own work in tandem with the team, team-leader, and manager
* Flexible working hours - while there will be some core hours required for meeting with Engineering and Operations teams - much latitude is given in getting work done.

**Requirements**

title: Business Data Insights Senior Specialist
description:
We are looking for a skilled and versatile Data & AI Engineer who can own the full data-to-AI lifecycle — designing and building robust data pipelines using Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Databricks, and then using that data to build, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning and generative AI solutions with Azure Machine Learning and Azure OpenAI.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on experience across both disciplines: developing ETL/ELT pipelines, transforming structured and semi-structured data, and ensuring reliable data availability, as well as building RAG pipelines, integrating LLM-based solutions, and operationalizing models with MLOps best practices.
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable working with business stakeholders, data scientists, BI teams, product teams, and technical teams to understand requirements, design scalable data and AI solutions, and deliver measurable business value end to end — from raw data to production-ready AI features.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role: Data & AI Engineer**
**Work Experience**
5+ years of combined experience in data engineering and AI/ML engineering, including building scalable data pipelines and cloud data platforms as well as developing and deploying machine learning or generative AI solutions, in an Agile or DevOps environment.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a skilled and versatile Data & AI Engineer who can own the full data-to-AI lifecycle — designing and building robust data pipelines using Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Databricks, and then using that data to build, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning and generative AI solutions with Azure Machine Learning and Azure OpenAI.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on experience across both disciplines: developing ETL/ELT pipelines, transforming structured and semi-structured data, and ensuring reliable data availability, as well as building RAG pipelines, integrating LLM-based solutions, and operationalizing models with MLOps best practices.
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable working with business stakeholders, data scientists, BI teams, product teams, and technical teams to understand requirements, design scalable data and AI solutions, and deliver measurable business value end to end — from raw data to production-ready AI features.
  
  
**Key Skills**

* 4+ years of experience spanning data engineering and AI/ML engineering, with strong exposure to data integration, ETL/ELT development, and cloud-based data and AI platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory for building, scheduling, monitoring, and managing data pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Azure Data Lake Storage for storing, organizing, and managing large volumes of data.
* Experience with Azure Databricks, including notebooks, Spark SQL, PySpark, data transformation, and performance optimization.
* Strong SQL and Python skills for querying, transformation, data validation, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning or Azure AI Studio for training, deploying, and managing ML models.
* Practical experience with Azure OpenAI Service or similar LLM platforms, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and model integration.
* Experience building RAG pipelines using vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, FAISS, Pinecone) for grounding LLM responses in enterprise data.
* Experience with ML/AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, LangChain, or Semantic Kernel.
* Good understanding of data lake architecture (bronze, silver, gold / medallion architecture) and MLOps practices (model versioning, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, retraining).
* Experience with data modelling, data quality checks, data profiling, reconciliation, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
* Exposure to DevOps practices such as Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), version control, and deployment processes.
* Working knowledge of Power BI or similar reporting tools, and knowledge of legacy ETL tools (Informatica, SSIS, Teradata, Oracle) will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Databricks, SQL, and related technologies.
* Build automated ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, validate, and publish data for analytics, reporting, and AI model consumption.
* Design, build, and fine-tune machine learning and generative AI models to solve business problems, using the curated data pipelines as the foundation.
* Develop RAG pipelines and integrate LLM-based solutions with enterprise data sources and applications.
* Work with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured datasets, preparing them for both analytics and model training/evaluation.
* Develop data and model transformation logic using SQL, PySpark, Spark SQL, Databricks notebooks, and Python ML frameworks.
* Create and maintain reliable data flows and AI services across raw, curated, and consumption-ready layers, including production model inference.
* Perform data exploration, validation, reconciliation, model evaluation, and performance testing to ensure accuracy and reliability end to end.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, BI developers, product owners, and architects to convert requirements into technical data and AI solutions.
* Support data migration, system integration, and AI feature rollout, from legacy platforms to cloud-based data and AI platforms.
* Monitor pipeline and model performance in production, troubleshoot failures, optimize processing/inference cost and latency, and ensure timely availability.
* Implement data quality rules, responsible AI practices, exception handling, logging, audit checks, and operational controls.
* Contribute to documentation of data flows, model architecture, source-to-target mappings, technical designs, and operational support procedures.
* Participate in E2E product lifecycle activities including design, development, testing, deployment, run support, retraining, refactoring, and decommissioning of outdated solutions.
* Continuously improve existing data and AI engineering processes through automation, standardization, and reusable components.

**Business And Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of both data engineering and AI/ML concepts — data pipelines, data integration, data modelling, model lifecycle, and cloud-based platforms.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical designs spanning data and AI.
* Experience in working with data structures, storage systems, model architectures, data quality frameworks, and system integrations.
* Good understanding of enterprise data flows, upstream and downstream dependencies, and AI/reporting consumption patterns.
* Ability to quickly analyze existing data and AI solutions and recommend improvements, automation opportunities, or alternative approaches.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues across pipelines, databases, models, and application layers.
* Experience working in Agile teams with E2E ownership of deliverables, from data ingestion through to deployed AI features.
* Ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Good documentation skills, including technical design documents, model cards, process flows, data mapping, and support guides.

**General Skills**

* Strong team player with the ability to work independently when required.
* High ownership mindset with a focus on delivering reliable and scalable data and AI solutions.
* Open to learning new technologies and applying them to improve existing processes.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to understand end-to-end business processes and data/AI dependencies.
* Good communication skills with the ability to explain technical data and AI concepts in a simple and clear manner.
* Proactive approach toward automation, optimization, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate or postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications in Azure Data Engineering, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Machine Learning, or generative AI technologies will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Technology Stack**
**Cloud & Data Platform:**
Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks
  
  
**Cloud & AI Platform:**
Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Studio, Azure OpenAI Service
  
  
**Programming & Querying:**
SQL, Python, PySpark, Spark SQL
  
  
**AI/ML Frameworks:**
PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, LangChain, Semantic Kernel
  
  
**Data & AI Engineering:**
ETL, ELT, data pipelines, data modelling, data quality, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, MLOps
  
  
**Vector Search & Data:**
Azure AI Search, FAISS, Pinecone, vector databases
  
  
**BI & Reporting:**
Power BI, SSRS or equivalent visualization tools
  
  
**DevOps & Delivery:**
Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Agile delivery practices
  
  
**Legacy or Enterprise Systems:**
Informatica, SSIS, Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server

description:

Verizon is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Principal Security Engineer to join our Data as a Service (DaaS) & Analytics team. In this senior individual contributor role , you will act as the technical North Star for our analytics engineering teams, driving the cloud-native automation strategies required to expose critical enterprise security data via robust APIs and interactive dashboards. This is an execution-focused, "hands-on with code" position. You will architect and build modern data products, leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem to design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and serverless application architectures.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Architecting and optimizing large-scale security data repositories within Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient partitioning, clustering, and storage tiering to support multi-terabyte analytical queries.
* Designing and implementing robust, low-latency data pipelines using GCP Dataflow services (Apache Beam) to ingest, transform, and aggregate batch and streaming data from disparate security sources into centralized data platforms.
* Designing and maintaining optimized data layers using the GCP Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL engine) to support high-throughput analytics and data consumers.
* Leading analytics engineers technically to architect and deploy production-grade automation solutions. Utilize GCP Cloud Run and Cloud Functions to build scalable, event-driven microservices and high-performance APIs that expose enterprise security data.
* Identifying opportunities to integrate AI/ML automation (e.g., Vertex AI, LLMs) to streamline manual data extraction, automate metadata tagging, and optimize pipeline orchestration.
* Driving the transition from standard visualization to a scalable data product model, establishing a comprehensive Looker dashboard catalog to streamline enterprise risk forecasting.
* Developing and maintaining a standardized semantic layer using LookML (Looker Modeling Language) to ensure data consistency, security access controls, and reusability across all security domains.
* Building comprehensive business cases and data models surrounding Enterprise Security Data Analysis and Reporting to drive long-term security investments.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Proven experience architecting and developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform, specifically leveraging containerized deployments via Cloud Run and serverless computing via Cloud Functions.
* Deep technical mastery of Google BigQuery architecture, including nested/repeated fields, materialized views, and BigQuery Omni or ML capabilities.
* Hands-on experience building streaming and batch data processing pipelines using GCP Dataflow services.
* Advanced proficiency in writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Strong hands-on coding expertise in Python to perform advanced data analysis, data mining, DevSecOps automation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Familiarity with deploying AI-driven automation workflows to improve data pipeline resilience.
* Experience utilizing visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Thoughtspot) to build data-driven stories tailored for business users at all levels.
* Experience embedding Looker visualizations directly into serverless applications or enterprise API frameworks is highly desirable.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science/Information Systems or six or more years of work experience.
* Eight or more years of professional experience in data analytics, business analysis or comparable analytics position.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Ability to write SQL against a relational database in order to analyze and test data.
* Experience with modern DataOps/DevSecOps orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, CI/CD pipelines) applied directly to data engineering.
* Working knowledge on Threat, Risk and Vulnerability Management is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of securing cloud data delivery layers (OAuth, OIDC, API Gateways) and enforcing data privacy/governance standards.
* Cloud Certifications

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Experience in technology leadership, architecture, and Agile methodologies.
* Communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Problem solving skills to develop quick yet sound solutions to resolve complex issues.
* Experience in driving AI automation, delivering high performing and scalable applications.
* Experience with DevOps CI/CD processes to automate build and deployments.
* Experience mentoring and coaching diverse teams.
* Experience in identifying and analyzing and finding RCA for Errors and working with cross functional teams like SRE and backend team
* Experience with analytical tools and DBs like Postgres, Looker , ELK, ETL tools
* Recognizing, tracking, and communicating issues, accomplishments, milestones to the team and business partners.
* Professional Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification.
* Good presentation and communication skills.

Where you’ll be working

40

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About The Role**
**About Soar and how we build :**
Soar is building an AI-native home-financing platform for Saudi Arabia, and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. Our product spans origination, credit decisioning, loan management, collections and investor products, all under SAMA regulation.
  
We build differently. Our engineers don't hand-write code; they specify, direct and review AI agents that do. If that sounds like where engineering is going, you'll fit here.
  
How we work :
  
Agents write the code. Engineers own the spec, the context, the tests and the review. DevOps doesn't hand-manage servers either.
  
Context engineering is the core skill. Agents work from a shared knowledge graph of business rules, architecture principles and money-movement rules that we keep current.
  
We build our own agents. Requirements, DevOps, PM and self-testing agents run on our MCP/A2A framework to automate the SDLC end to end.
  
Full stack by default. AI closes skill gaps, so engineers work across backend, frontend and infrastructure, with cross-domain reviewers.
  
Regulated means rigorous. Money-movement logic gets human review, every time. KSA data residency shapes which models and tools we use and where they run.
  
What every role here needs: you already use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) as your main way of working, not as autocomplete. You can show us real workflows you've built, where they broke, and what you changed.
  
**Role Summary:**
We rely heavily on AI to build, test, and improve software. We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager who can lead a team of engineers working with AI agents, keep delivery focused, and ensure every release meets a high quality bar. You will combine people leadership with practical technical oversight and help your team become more effective every week.
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the team’s delivery from requirements through production, with clear scope, acceptance criteria, priorities, and accountability.
* Coach engineers to use AI agents effectively for implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation; contribute directly when needed.
* Help the team break complex work into reviewable tasks, provide relevant context to agents, and validate results against product requirements.
* Review designs and critical code changes, challenge unsupported AI assumptions, and ensure changes remain understandable and maintainable.
* Embed automated tests, peer review, CI checks, security checks, and end-to-end validation into delivery; keep human review accountable for release decisions.
* Partner with Product, QA, and DevOps to resolve blockers, prepare releases, and address production issues and recurring defects.
* Run regular one-to-ones, give actionable feedback, support career growth, and manage workloads sustainably.
* Improve team practices using evidence from delivery lead time, escaped defects, reliability, and AI usage costs.

**Requirements**

title: AI Architect
description:
**AI Architect – Core Agentic AI**

Experience: 10–14 years total; 4+ years in ML/AI, including 2+ years building LLM and agentic systems in production

Function: Core AI Platform / Agentic AI CoE

Reports to: Head of AI / Chief Architect

Location: [Chennai / Bangalore] – Hybrid

Employment: Full-time

**Role summary**

The AI Architect owns the end-to-end technical architecture of our agentic AI platform: how agents reason, plan, call tools, remember, and stay safe at enterprise scale. You set the reference architecture, patterns and guardrails that every AI product team builds on, and you are the final technical authority on agent design choices.

**Key responsibilities**

**Architecture and design**

* Define the reference
  **architecture for single- and multi-agent systems**
  : orchestration, planning, tool use, memory, state, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Choose and justify agent patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, supervisor/worker, graph-based workflows) for each use case.
* Design the tool and integration layer, including
  **Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers**
  , function-calling contracts and enterprise API access.
* Architect retrieval and memory: RAG pipelines, hybrid search, vector and graph stores, short- and long-term agent memory.
* Set the model strategy: frontier API models vs. open-weight models, routing, fallbacks, fine-tuning vs. prompting, and cost/latency trade-offs.

**Platform, scale and reliability**

* Design for production: latency budgets, concurrency, caching, token cost controls, and graceful degradation.
* Define the LLMOps/AgentOps stack: tracing, evaluation, prompt and model versioning, observability and rollback.
* Establish evaluation frameworks covering task success, tool-call accuracy, hallucination rate, safety, and regression testing.

**Governance, security and Responsible AI**

* Build guardrails against prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool actions and over-permissioned agents.
* Define identity, authorization and audit for agents acting on behalf of users.
* Align designs with data privacy and AI regulation (e.g. DPDP Act, GDPR, EU AI Act where relevant) and internal Responsible AI policy.

**Leadership and influence**

* Run architecture reviews and write design docs, ADRs and reference implementations.
* Translate business problems into agentic solutions with clear ROI with product and business stakeholders.
* Evaluate emerging frameworks, models and vendors, and decide build vs. buy.
* Mentor senior engineers and grow architecture capability across teams.

**Must-have qualifications**

* 10–14 years in software engineering/architecture, with
  **4+ years in ML/AI and 2+ years shipping LLM-based or agentic systems to production.**
* Deep hands-on knowledge of LLM application design: prompting, function/tool calling, structured outputs, context management, RAG.
* Working experience with agent frameworks such as
  **LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex,**
  CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK or Claude Agent SDK.
* Experience with major
  **LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock)**
  and open-weight models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen).
* Strong distributed-systems background: microservices, event-driven design, APIs, queues, async workflows.
* **Vector databases and search**
  : Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.
* Cloud architecture on at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP, with Kubernetes and containerisation.
* Strong
  **Python,**
  working knowledge of Java, TypeScript or Go.
* Proven record of owning architecture decisions with measurable business outcomes.

**Good to have**

* MCP server design and agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols.
* Fine-tuning and alignment techniques: LoRA/QLoRA, SFT, DPO; model serving with vLLM, TGI or Triton.
* Knowledge graphs and GraphRAG.
* Observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Weights & Biases.
* Cloud architect certification (AWS / Azure / GCP); publications, patents or open-source contributions in AI.
* Domain exposure to BFSI, healthcare, retail, manufacturing or supply chain.

**Education**

B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech/MS in Computer Science, AI, Data Science or a related field. PhD a plus, not required.

**Success in the first 12 months**

* A published agentic reference architecture adopted by all AI product teams.
* 3+ agentic use cases moved from pilot to production with defined SLAs and evaluation gates.
* A guardrail and evaluation framework in place, with measurable drops in hallucination and unsafe-action rates.
* Clear reduction in LLM cost per transaction through routing, caching and model selection.

The candidate should have knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intent parsing, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI orchestration, and GPU-accelerated computing.

The role involves working with locally hosted AI models and NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, including NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell and L40S. The candidate will also be responsible for application containerization, Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization, performance optimization, scalability, networking, security, and maintaining reliable on-premises AI environments.

The ideal candidate should be capable of taking AI applications from development and experimentation through deployment, optimization, and production maintenance.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. LLM Deployment & On-Premises AI

• Deploy, configure, and manage locally hosted LLMs such as Qwen, Mistral, Kimi, and other suitable open-weight models.

• Work with inference frameworks such as Ollama, vLLM, and similar model-serving technologies.

• Deploy AI workloads on NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell, L40S, and compatible GPU infrastructure.

• Optimize model inference, GPU utilization, VRAM consumption, response latency, and throughput.

• Evaluate model performance, tool-calling capabilities, accuracy, and hardware requirements.

• Implement quantization, batching, streaming inference, and other optimization techniques where appropriate.

• Troubleshoot GPU drivers, CUDA compatibility, memory allocation, and model-serving issues.

• Maintain local AI deployments with an emphasis on data governance, privacy, and reduced dependence on external AI services.

**2. RAG, Intent Parsing & AI Orchestration**

• Develop RAG pipelines for retrieving information from documents, databases, and enterprise data sources.

• Implement document parsing, text extraction, OCR where required, chunking, embeddings, vector search, and reranking.

• Build intent-parsing and routing mechanisms to identify user requirements and determine the appropriate processing workflow.

• Implement LLM-based tool calling and function calling to interact with APIs, databases, and third-party applications.

• Develop multi-step orchestration workflows involving retrieval, tool selection, execution, and response generation.

• Implement MCP servers and clients to connect AI models with compatible tools and data sources.

• Design and maintain centralized tool registries with tool definitions, input schemas, execution handlers, and permissions.

• Implement guardrails, validation, fallback mechanisms, error handling, and controlled tool execution.

• Improve response accuracy, contextual relevance, source attribution, and reliability.

**3. Backend Development & Application Integration**

• Develop backend services and REST APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI.

• Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, databases, document repositories, and third-party APIs.

• Build reusable connectors for data retrieval and authorized application actions.

• Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs, session management, and streaming responses.

• Develop modular services for model inference, orchestration, retrieval, and external integrations.

• Write automated tests, technical documentation, and deployment scripts.

• Collaborate with frontend and infrastructure teams to deliver end-to-end AI applications.

**4. Real-Time Voice AI & Conversational Systems**

• Develop AI-powered conversational applications supporting real-time voice interactions.

• Integrate speech-to-text, LLM inference, text-to-speech, and optional avatar animation.

• Work with technologies such as Faster-Whisper/Whisper, Kokoro TTS, MuseTalk, and NVIDIA Audio2Face.

• Build low-latency audio-processing pipelines and streaming conversational workflows.

• Implement conversation context management, interruption handling, session management, and error recovery.

• Optimize audio processing, inference latency, GPU utilization, and concurrent session handling.

• Integrate voice AI components with backend APIs and application interfaces.

**5. Microsoft Hyper-V & On-Premises Infrastructure**

• Provision, configure, and manage virtual machines using Microsoft Hyper-V.

• Deploy and maintain Windows Server and Linux environments for AI applications and supporting services.

• Configure virtual CPU, memory, storage, networking, and resource allocation.

• Enable and troubleshoot GPU access for virtualized AI workloads using supported GPU-P or passthrough configurations, depending on hardware and operating-system compatibility.

• Understand GPU virtualization requirements for NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell and L40S platforms.

• Deploy AI inference services and supporting applications across virtual machines and physical servers.

• Configure virtual switches, network segmentation, firewalls, DNS, and secure service communication.

• Troubleshoot virtualization, GPU availability, driver compatibility, storage, and networking issues.

• Maintain infrastructure documentation, backup procedures, and operational runbooks.

**6. Containerization & Deployment**

• Containerize AI models, backend services, RAG pipelines, MCP services, and voice-processing components using Docker.

• Use Docker Compose or similar technologies to manage multi-service applications.

• Configure GPU access for supported NVIDIA-enabled containers.

• Manage environment variables, secrets, persistent storage, service dependencies, and deployment configurations.

• Deploy applications across Hyper-V virtual machines and on-premises GPU servers.

• Implement health checks, logging, monitoring, service recovery, and deployment automation.

• Maintain reproducible and reliable deployment environments.

**7. Performance, Scalability & Reliability**

• Benchmark inference latency, time to first token, tokens per second, throughput, and concurrent user capacity.

• Identify CPU, GPU, VRAM, storage, and networking bottlenecks.

• Optimize resource allocation for multiple AI models, applications, and concurrent users.

• Implement caching, asynchronous processing, queues, batching, and streaming where appropriate.

• Design reliable services with timeouts, retries, fallback mechanisms, and graceful error handling.

• Monitor GPU utilization, memory consumption, application health, and inference performance.

• Ensure AI applications remain scalable, maintainable, and reliable as workloads increase.

**8. Security & Maintainability**

• Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access controls, and secure API integrations.

• Configure TLS, reverse proxies, firewalls, and secure inter-service communication.

• Apply appropriate access restrictions to tools, documents, databases, and connected applications.

• Implement input validation, output validation, audit logging, and secrets management.

• Ensure that RAG retrieval and tool execution respect user permissions and tenant boundaries.

• Maintain clean, modular, testable code and well-documented infrastructure.

• Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve system security and stability.

**Example Use Cases**

**The engineer may work on use cases such as:**

**1. Real-Time AI Companion**

Develop an AI companion that interacts with users in live, one-on-one sessions and answers queries through natural conversations. This may involve locally hosted LLMs, Faster-Whisper for speech recognition, Kokoro for speech generation, and MuseTalk or NVIDIA Audio2Face for avatar animation. The focus is on low-latency interactions, conversational context, GPU optimization, and concurrent sessions.

**2. Multi-Source Enterprise Chatbot**

Develop a chatbot that retrieves information from multiple authorized data sources and interacts with connected applications. This may involve Qwen 14B or Mistral models, document parsing, RAG, API integrations, databases, MCP, and a tool registry. The processing workflow may include intent routing, retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, guardrails, and response generation.

**Required Technical Skills**

• Python programming and backend API development.

• Experience with or understanding of LLMs such as Qwen, Mistral, or Kimi.

• Familiarity with Ollama, vLLM, or similar inference frameworks.

• Knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.

• Understanding of intent parsing, tool calling, MCP, and AI orchestration.

• Experience with Docker and containerized application deployment.

• Practical knowledge of Microsoft Hyper-V and virtual machine management.

• Understanding of NVIDIA GPUs, GPU memory, inference performance, and model optimization.

• Knowledge of networking, security, and application troubleshooting.

**Preferred Skills**

• Experience with NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell, L40S, or comparable GPU infrastructure.

• Knowledge of CUDA, NVIDIA drivers, and GPU monitoring.

• Experience with GPU virtualization or passthrough in Hyper-V where supported.

• Familiarity with Windows Server, Linux, and virtual networking.

• Experience with Faster-Whisper, Kokoro, MuseTalk, NVIDIA Audio2Face, or related voice AI

technologies.

• Familiarity with MCP SDKs, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks.

• Knowledge of OCR, reranking, hybrid retrieval, and document-processing pipelines.

• Experience with reverse proxies, TLS, monitoring, logging, and CI/CD.

**Candidate Profile**

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Hands-on approach to AI development, deployment, and troubleshooting.

• Ability to work across LLMs, backend applications, and infrastructure.

• Understanding of the trade-offs between model quality, latency, GPU requirements, and scalability.

• Ability to develop maintainable and secure AI applications.

* Willingness to learn emerging LLM, agentic AI, voice AI, and GPU technologies.

* Select fit-for-purpose models, cloud services, vector stores, orchestration frameworks and evaluation approaches based on security, quality, latency, cost, scalability and maintainability requirements.
* Design API-first, event-driven and microservices-based integrations with enterprise applications, data platforms, workflow systems and user experience layers.
* Establish AI evaluation and observability covering retrieval quality, groundedness, accuracy, hallucination risk, agent trajectories, tool execution, latency, cost and user experience.
* Embed Responsible AI, privacy, security and compliance controls including PII protection, access control, auditability, prompt-injection mitigation, content safety, secure tool execution and data-leakage prevention.
* Define cloud-native deployment and operations patterns using containers, Kubernetes or managed services, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, model/LLM operations, monitoring and release controls.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, code reviews and production-readiness assessments; troubleshoot complex issues and guide performance optimization.
* Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, data scientists, engineers, UX teams, security and platform teams to ensure alignment from design through adoption.
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, estimates, executive presentations, accelerators, reusable assets and AI practice development.
* Lead and mentor architects and engineers, promote engineering standards, and build capability through coaching and knowledge sharing.

**Skills And Attributes**
**Professional experience**

* 10+ years of experience in AI, data, analytics, software engineering or digital transformation, including significant responsibility for solution architecture and end-to-end delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and deploying enterprise-scale AI/ML, GenAI, RAG or Agentic AI solutions in client-facing environments.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional teams, architecture governance, stakeholder engagement and complex delivery programs.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs and business value to technical and executive audiences.

**Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, Graph RAG, Agentic RAG, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, knowledge graphs, model evaluation and fine-tuning approaches.

**Why join us**

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy.
